harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL10) as systemd-managed services, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380, verified cross-member read/write replication, demonstrated write/read availability while node3 was stopped plus its subsequent catch-up, then sequentially rebooted all three nodes one at a time (preserving quorum throughout) and confirmed each node's boot identity changed and the cluster/data fully recovered after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd/etcdctl/etcdutl v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 tcp on all three nodes
Created etcd system user and systemd unit (etcd.service) on each node with a 3-member static initial-cluster config
Enabled and started etcd on all three nodes, forming a healthy 3-member cluster
Verified member list and endpoint health/status across all nodes
Wrote a key on node1, confirmed it was readable on node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read a key via node1/node2 (2/3 quorum), confirmed the outage did not block reads/writes
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up on the key written during its outage and cluster health returned to fully green
Captured boot_id and etcd/data health baseline on all three nodes

Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 via systemctl reboot (one at a time, preserving quorum), polled each until reachable, and confirmed changed boot_id plus recovered etcd service, cluster health, membership, and data on each

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3, membership healthy
evidence.summary: member list shows node1, node2, node3 all 'started'; endpoint health --cluster shows all 3 endpoints healthy=true

evidence.requirement: Key written on any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Key 'benchmark-key' written via node1 endpoint, then successfully read via node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: etcd stopped on node3; write+read of 'during-outage' key succeeded via node1/node2 endpoints while node3 was down (2/3 quorum maintained)

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: etcd restarted on node3; it successfully read the 'during-outage' key written during its downtime, and cluster health returned to all-true

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 7ef78016... and confirmed both keys readable on node1 pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acked and returned before disconnect; polling showed connection drop then boot_id changed to 5cf23ced...; etcd became active again; full 3/3 cluster health and both keys confirmed readable post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 636556ce... and confirmed both keys readable on node2 pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acked and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to b59901f2...; etcd active again; full 3/3 cluster health and both keys confirmed readable post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 254597f8... and confirmed both keys readable on node3 pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state, cluster quorum/membership
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acked and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to 1c08deed...; etcd active again; full 3/3 cluster health, member list showing all 3 members 'started', and both keys confirmed readable post-restart
